theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_em_cutoff_integral_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (η : ℝ → ℝ), μ (ball z r) < ∞ → ContDiff ℝ 1 η → (∀ u, 1 ≤ u → η u = 0) → ContinuousOn (fun t => ∫ x, η (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) ∂μ) (Ioc 0 r) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 r, HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ x, η (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) ∂μ) (-(∫ x, 2 * (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) * deriv η (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) ∂μ) / s) s
